text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Did you bear witness, Trainer?
To the moment of my triumph.
choice_data_list: はい。実に見事な勝ち姿でした！

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that's how it looked to your eyes,
can I take it that my run was worthy?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This victory is but a single petal of the splendor blooming across the Kingdom of the Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: When weighed against the prosperity we shall soon build, it could be deemed trivial, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To know that the days walked alongside you became fertile soil
from which this blossomed brings me genuine joy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: For now, let us share in the joy of this victory together.
choice_data_list: 光栄です。このまま邁進いたしましょう
はい。もちろん、次への備えも怠りません

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, momentum is essential at times.
We shall forge ahead without breaking our stride.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that attitude of never yielding to complacency.
It is truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I shall not drop my guard either.
I am prepared for whatever training you prescribe.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have already entrusted my very person to you, Trainer.
Do not hesitate to push me to my limits.
